purpose: Bounded local recovery and offline-transition benchmark for the persisted conversation work-run state machine.

scenarios.description: A persisted RUNNING run is reconciled after executor loss and becomes INTERRUPTED exactly once.
A run waiting for approval survives reconciliation and completes after an explicit approval and resume.
Queued messages complete in queue order and a repeated idempotency key returns the original run.
A failed tool action creates a user decision and retry executes only the failed target once.
Offline state blocks remote routing while retaining the deterministic local route.

claim_boundary: This benchmark certifies the bounded local persistence and policy state machine only.
The process_restart case simulates lost executor state by changing the persisted RUNNING marker; it is not physical packaged-app restart evidence.
The offline_transition case uses explicit routing and capability policy; it does not certify a network firewall or a live remote-provider outage.
No hosted CI, production deployment, signing, notarization, native-device, or live-model claim is made by this receipt.
Threshold changes require a versioned benchmark revision and justification.
